   `17291d7a6b31`: is-ancestor YES, first-parent no. The alternative
   `origin/issue-*` reachability probe was CONSIDERED and REJECTED (it is
   parent/child symmetric, so a branch forked OFF this one fires it identically
   to a genuine unmerged parent — reintroducing the same false-UNSAFE class).

   UNCONDITIONAL — today it is gated on `BEHIND > 200`, so demoting the
   first-parent arm without that change would be a fail-OPEN for same-hour
   branches, which is precisely the two-concurrent-siblings window. Making it
   unconditional also closes a PRE-EXISTING hole.

   surgical checkout is `--diff-filter=A`, so the clobber hazard is closed by
   design (one narrow pre-existing residual named rather than claimed away). The
   real harm is SILENT STRANDING of MODIFIED shared infra (#1144), so D4 surfaces
   it loudly instead of adding a fleet-wide blocking route.
